notes.title: KR: DC plays great on the Steam Deck or with a controller!
notes.content:
Hello, detectives!

We wanted to emphasize to you all that Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut features full controller support, including Steam Deck compatibility!

As some of you may know, the Steam Deck is officially launching today, and we’ve had first-hand experience with this new handheld. You’re in for a treat — the Director’s Cut plays AMAZINGLY on it! 

[h3]For a more relaxed playthrough, plug in, sit back, seamlessly take control of Kathy and crack the case, either on your Steam Deck or with any other controller![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11113042/5d67405d4ea858dffdca16612e1b1fd3515e62e7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.1.5026 released!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch v.1.0.1.5026 changelog:[/h1]

[h2][b]Engine:[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Updated our Unity version to 2019.4.31f to improve overall compatibility, stability and performance
[*] Added MacOS 12 Support
[/list]

[*] Fixed a soft lock if the player picks up the flower and shovel in the nature reserve on day 3 but ignores the drawing
[*] Kathy can no longer get stuck if the player mashes the skip button as she is picking up the scarab

notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is Live!
notes.content:
It’s been 5 years since we released Kathy Rain, and launch day for the Director’s Cut is finally upon us! We couldn’t be more excited to share our third game with you all — the definite version of Kathy Rain. We believe that KR: DC elevates Kathy’s journey to a whole new level, opening many doors for the future of Kathy Rain!

While you wait for the download to start, enjoy our launch trailer below, and as always — thank you for being here. We wouldn’t be able to do this if it wasn’t for all of you, and we sincerely hope that Kathy will bring you some joy in this spooky season! 

[url=https://youtu.be/JGlwmyh3TFQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/33be185537d8dde85045332dc2183185f99255f8.jpg[/img][/url]

- Clifftop Games

notes.title: Her name is Rain, Kathy Rain
notes.content:
For those who have yet to take this journey, we want to introduce you to the central figure of the story — Kathy herself! We think Kathy is a very special character, and here are some of the reasons why:

[b]Kathy = Badass[/b]
[list]
[*] Rides a sweet hog
[*] Doesn’t take shit from anyone, no matter if they're law enforcement, biker thugs, or... [REDACTED]. [*] When the cause is just, Kathy bravely takes on anyone who stands in her way
[*] Fiercely protective of her family and friends… even when they’re annoying the hell out of her.
[*] I mean… just look at her. Enough said!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/ef1a2810a28637e5c5440064a37dc4d0e819519f.jpg[/img]


[b]Kathy = Charming (when she needs to be)[/b]
[list]
[*] Even when met with hostility, Kathy can win over the grumpiest of adversaries! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/334b102b0bbc24d17bd5a7d8be708ff169a68ee6.jpg[/img]


[b]Kathy = Shrewd[/b]
[list]
[*] No mystery is too cryptic for our gumshoe — she’ll get to the bottom of any puzzle!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/11d691a2828b914a992564e17b5ba27f4e65cde6.jpg[/img]
[i](What, did you think we were just going to give you this one? ;) Remember, Kathy Rain: Director's Cut is launching on October 26th!)[/i]


We’re proud of how far Kathy has come since the original launch in 2016, and we're excited to show off her new scenes from the Director’s Cut when we launch on October 26th!

- Clifftop Games and Raw Fury

notes.title: Director’s Cut Highlights
notes.content:
Welcome to our TED talk, highlighting the changes and upgrades to Kathy Rain in its Director’s Cut. A lot of people have been asking us what the differences are between the original and the upcoming version, so we wanted to highlight some of the major reasons that it's worth returning to Conwell Springs!

[b]Added Locations:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/cc1994ff204e98557a5214fa2b22af41c8eb91ed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/787fc3fad15bf231476482caa2ae770222080f12.jpg[/img]

There is more to love in Conwell Springs as new and returning players will have the chance to explore brand new areas of Kathy’s hometown. Each new location features stunning backgrounds as seen in the examples above!


[b]Added Puzzles:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/f126b38ca70735a79180b91d10fb1e7c5d64118d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/4590650930200ffe6cad65fb9fb8f503a583f28f.jpg[/img]

What’s a good point-and-click mystery without its challenging puzzles? Kathy Rain had some doozies and the Director’s Cut is bringing more of those challenges that will tease your brain.

[b]Extended Ending:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/363e30ef173e32c65df01a87a9bbe8689f1e2eca.jpg[/img]

OK, the above image is a bit of a tease and we don’t want to spoil anything, but players returning to Kathy Rain can expect some new twists and turns to the ending that help flesh out Kathy’s character and the story as a whole.

Aspect Ratio:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/a9969ae9baf3c7b24c57d40ac635b66d90096d8f.jpg[/img]

Kathy Rain is expanding from 4:3 to 16:9. This means that there will be more details to explore as the Director’s Cut will fill up your screen!

Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is launching in October of this year — make sure it’s on your wishlist as we will be taking a deep dive into the game right here on Steam.

- Clifftop Games

notes.title: Save and Sound Festival Starts Today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248613/070411cc16fdd0bacacdec7de726181b75bf3f8b.jpg[/img]

Kathy Rain: Director's Cut is a part of the Save and Sound Festival on Steam, starting today! This festival focuses on the music of videogames, and we've got a great video that will be playing on Raw Fury's feature block starting around 11:30am PT/2:30pm ET/8:30pm CET.  Visit [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url] for the full schedule!

Check out some really cool videos from us and others from the Raw Fury family:
  - Kathy Rain - Daniel Kobylarz discusses how music heightens the game experience and his return to the Kathy Rain universe 5 years after it's initial release
  - Atomicrops - Joonas Turner takes us through the found-object music creation process he used to create the Atomicrops soundtrack
  - Star Renegades - Composer Steve London breaks down what it takes to score a rebellion
  - Call of the Sea - Composer, Eduardo dela Iglesia talks about the inspiration behind Call of the Sea and conducts an orchestra in a live performance of the soundtrack.
  - The Longest Road on Earth - The developers at Brainwash Gang take viewers through the last chapter of their game, chat about making a game that focuses on music, and include an acoustic version of "The Shape of Clouds"

notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut Announcement
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the Director’s Cut of the award-winning adventure Kathy Rain — the new and definite way to experience the rise of an iconic detective.

In the almost five years since Kathy Rain launched, we’ve been blown away by the reception of the game and the passion of the community. Thanks to everyone that has played the game so far, given feedback and shared their experience!

All of this has led us to our mission to create a refined and expanded version of Kathy Rain, created from the ground up in a modern, up-to-date game engine.

We have taken everything we’ve learned during these years to give you the most complete realization of Kathy’s journey yet. Once again, a detective is born...

[previewyoutube=SV5-E0mm7zc;full][/previewyoutube]

For both new and returning visitors to Conwell Springs, there’s lots to look forward to...

[list]
[*] Extended storyline with a prolonged ending, hundreds of lines of additional dialogue, and multiple new areas to explore.
[*] Several new major puzzle chains along with many small additions and tweaks of existing puzzles.
[*] Enlarged game environments to fill up the entire screen without any black bars on the sides.
[*] Countless visual improvements, such as more character animations, better lighting/shadows and extra weather effects.
[*] Streamlined mouse controls with an intuitive single click interface.
[*] Controller support done right. Lean back in your chair and take smooth direct control of Kathy, with no messy cursor getting in the way.
[*] Expanded and remixed soundtrack by the original composer, Daniel Kobylarz.
[*] Five brand new motorcycle designs to unlock and customize the Katmobile with.
[/list]

We’ve still got more to show of Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut, so stay tuned. We’d appreciate you wishlisting the game to show both us and Steam that you’re looking forward to playing!
